title: Replace monolithic Make bootstrap with modular Go build harness and manifest verifier
author: Priya Patel
release_notes: Replaces Make-based monorepo bootstrap with a hermetic Go-based build harness to improve parallelism, traceability, and incremental caching. Includes a manifest verifier to catch inconsistent dependency files prior to CI. No runtime API changes.
description: Motivation: the legacy monorepo bootstrap (root Makefile + bash glue) has become brittle, slow, and hard to reason about for parallel CI lanes and remote cache warmup. This PR introduces a lightweight Go build harness (gobldr) and a declarative dependency manifest verifier to modularize bootstrap steps, provide hermetic execution, and make preflight checks explicit. Summary: adds a small Go CLI (build/cmd/gobldr) that encodes canonical bootstrap stages (toolchain setup, vendoring, artifact generation, release stamping), a manifest verifier (build/manifest/verifier.go) that validates go.mod / package-lock.json / pnpm-lock.yaml / cargo.lock consistency against a generated manifest, and replaces the top-level Makefile targets used by CI with concise wrappers that invoke gobldr. The change also updates .github/workflows/ci.yml to call gobldr with stage flags and wires gobldr to the existing remote-cache priming endpoint. Checklist: - [x] Introduce gobldr CLI with modular stage runner - [x] Manifest verifier and example manifest for redwood/ - [x] Replace heavy bash Make targets with small wrappers - [x] Update CI workflows to call gobldr stages and preserve cache keys - [x] Unit and integration tests for verifier and harness - [x] Rollout in canary: gated on fastlane for infra/ repo. Commits (high-level): - init: add gobldr CLI scaffold and command parsing - build: implement stage runner and parallel executor - manifest: add verifier and rule set for multi-language lockfiles - ci: switch workflows to use gobldr stage invocation - tests: add unit tests and small integration shim - docs: document new bootstrap flow and migration notes Changed areas (high level): build/cmd/gobldr/*, build/manifest/*, Makefile (top-level wrappers only), .github/workflows/ci.yml, scripts/ci-cache-prime.sh (reworked to call gobldr), docs/dev/bootstrap.md, tests/manifest/* Testing and rollout: ran local unit tests and CI integration lane; staged rollout on infra-fastlane for one week, then enabled for all PRs. Observability: gobldr emits structured JSON telemetry on stage start/finish which is captured by existing CI logs and sent to the CI telemetry pipeline. Backwards compatibility: Makefile wrappers remain to avoid breakage for local developers who still call make; documentation updated with migration steps and examples. Related: ENG-3347 (refactor CI bootstrap), ENG-3380 (dep sanity checks).
